# Apple-1 netlist, extracted from "a1 circuit.pdf" (P-CAD redraw by MIKE_A, 2015). Sheets 1 (terminal) and 2 (processor); power supply omitted.
# Format: COMPONENT lines: ref | type | value | sheet.  NET lines: netname: ref.pin ref.pin ...
# Net names are the schematic labels (a leading / means an overbar / active-low label). Auto-generated names start with _ (_S<sheet>_<id>).
# Pins with no wire attached appear on their own NC line. Refs with a colon (ICD10:C) are section C of package ICD10; refs with a trailing letter and NO colon (ICC11A, ICC11B, ICD4A/B, ICD5A/B, ICD14A/B) are separate chips, as drawn on the schematic.
# Two-terminal parts (R, C, CR, ZQ, JMP) use .1/.2 numbered top-to-bottom / left-to-right on the drawing; diode polarity was NOT extracted.
# Transistor pins B/C/E were inferred from symbol orientation (base = odd one out, C above E) - verify against the drawing.
# J3 (slot) and J4 (PCB edge) pins: 1-22 numeric side; the drawing numbers the other side 23-44, mapped here to letters Z..A (no G/I/O/Q) per the sheet-3 pinout, so J3.A = O2, J3.W = A0 etc.
